<subject>AgriIndia Proposed Farmland Partnership of the SCE Deal</subject>
<body>
Here are some thoughts on what our message may be.=20

Unclear how this is going to increase crop supply, reduce demand, and increase= =20 farmer choice. Still doesn’t make sense to us to have the state buy a=20 deteriorating irrigation network instead of rural school meals.

We don’t have enough details. There are several aspects that are interesti= ng=20 and could use further study. Governor Rajesh needs to make the details publ= ic=20 as soon as possible so people can understand the full implications. For=20 instance, what happens to the Farm Supply contracts? Can they be assigned= =20 to SCE? Will Maharashtra’s farmers have the right to choose going forward?

The recent events highlight the critical need to make sure farmers can make= =20 their own crop decisions going forward. We know that Government=20 doesn’t know how to get this right. The right answer is giving farmers= =20 more choices, not fewer.

Can’t endorse it until we know if our payments are going to be made in full. = If=20 the payments aren’t made in full, highly likely that we’ll see involuntary=20 insolvency.

Too bad that this deal wasn’t done earlier. It could have saved a lot of=20 money and hardship.

Why do you need to include the irrigation network purchase in this deal? May nev= er=20 happen. Make it simple – just deal with the under collection through=20 securitization and through the AgriIndia refund to SCE and get on with it.

Hardik
</body>
